title: The Third-Time Princess Blooms in the Orphanage ~I'm Starting My Life Over, But Despite Hiding My Identity, I've Somehow Captured His Highness's Heart~
description:
Princess Alisha loses her life in a burning mansion when she gets caught up in a coup d'état during a secret rendezvous with the next emperor, Seil. However, when she opens her eyes, she finds herself back in the orphanage where she once hid her true identity during her childhood...

Realizing she has regressed six years into the past, Alisha stands up to protect everyone from the wicked orphanage director who is trafficking the children. Armed with her brilliant mind, magic, and memories of her past life, she is determined to change the future!

To save the ones she loves, and to truly be happy this time around, she will change the future with her own hands-- The curtain rises on this "death-regression" fantasy of a princess starting her life over!
author: Hiirono ame
